latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Windows WeChat MCP – automates message monitoring and sending using window automation.

- Send messages to specified or current WeChat contacts directly from your Windows desktop.
- Capture screenshots of the WeChat window.
- Detect and interact with detached chat (“Dragon”) windows.
- Check WeChat window status, including position and running state.
- Use via Python or call built-in MCP tools for integration with other workflows.
